title: adopt evals-guidelines: first tier-0 battery + one tier-1 scenario (dont)
description:
Per-repo adoption of the suite-wide evals guidelines (openspec change `add-evals-guidelines` in genesis, spec: `openspec/specs/evals-guidelines/spec.md` once archived).

Scope for this repo:
- Tier-0 battery: static checks, no model — envelope/schema checks, doc-sync guards, scenario provenance declarations. Runs on every push.
- One tier-1 scenario: `Scenario::run` replay of one recorded failure mode, nightly.
- Tier 2 (live models) is DEFERRED until the tier-0/1 battery is stable.
- Register genesis's `EvalsGuidelinesAdoption` linter (adoption probe).
- Emit report rows in the `report_version` 1 JSON contract: docs/reference/eval-report.md in genesis (normative fixtures `tests/golden/eval_report_*.json`).

Reference pages (genesis book): how-to/evals.md (tier ladder + action protocol), how-to/evals-ci.md (CI wiring), reference/eval-report.md (report contract), explanation/why-weak-readers.md.
